_note: Manual v1 (2026-10-12) is the current Peptides, SARMs, and Research Chemicals Program Manual for Category 26. The house DOI suffix hmtc.manual.peptides-sarms-and-research-chemicals is reserved for deposit. cert_doi stays empty until that deposit. Method edition is at /program/method.

versions.label: Manual v1
versions.summary: First Category 26 Program Manual. Five standards, ICH Q3D read-across for seven metals, FDA injectable aluminium (25) on injectable and nasal standards, EU drinking-water aluminium (200) on raw powders and oral SARMs. Species capped at the parent total and tested on the program retest schedule. Metal safety only.
